column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# The hook and the command share the artifact id `scan` (hooks/scan.sh, commands/scan.md);
# they resolve by kind and own different territories — the hook denies a secret on its
# way to disk, the command sweeps for one already committed.

column5: PreToolUse Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit, or Bash with a write target (heredoc body, echo/printf argument), whose new text matches a high-confidence secret shape (AWS key id, private-key block, GitHub/Slack token, Google API key, Stripe live key, assigned secret literal); PostToolUse or PostToolUseFailure, warning only, a file a Bash interpreter/cp/mv/install/patch run changed in git whose added text matches one

PreToolUse Bash running git commit or git push at a command position (past env assignments, wrappers, cd and git -C) whose added lines match a high-confidence secret shape outside the placeholder escape: the staged lines; with -a/-i/-o, a pathspec or an earlier git add in the command, tracked changes against HEAD plus the untracked files that add names; for a push, each commit it sends that the destination's remote-tracking refs lack
invoked as /secret-scanning:scan [path-or-diff]; the user asks whether a secret is already in the tree or a diff
writing config or .env, wiring an API client, pasting a key, or reading a diff for leaked credentials

PostToolUse on a Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit/Read, or PostToolUse or PostToolUseFailure on a Bash command writing up to 8 files under the project root (or, after an interpreter/cp/mv/install/patch run, changing up to 8 in git), whose file carries zero-width, bidi-override or tag-block codepoints

a prompt.mention of a file whose text or mentioned lines carry a secret-pattern match; a prompt.attachment of type file, already_read_file or edited_text_file carrying one; a prompt.edit draft or a composer/sdk prompt.submit carrying one; each with CC_SECRET_PROMPT (or cc_secret_prompt) not off: painted in the draft, then masked, sent as typed or dropped as the person answers (masked when nobody can; a slash command dropped unless sent as typed); hooks no tool call

PostToolUse or PostToolUseFailure on any tool whose string output fields (or error) carry a non-placeholder secret-pattern match, an assigned value whose directory part exists under the call's cwd excepted, with CC_SECRET_OUTPUT_SCAN (or cc_secret_output_scan) not off; one context line naming each label, never the value
